title: After switching Light Switch ON and exiting the GUI - it turns back OFF
summary: Await the already-requested current-version result, with one explicit Settings-only persistence control.

evidence: The original 0.102.2933 report says Light Switch returns to Off after leaving and reopening the GUI, without distinguishing the enable toggle from theme/schedule state or closing Settings from exiting PowerToys.

The existing focused source/history investigation and current duplicate search identify no exact persistence fix; default-on/off and schedule-mode reports describe different states.
judgment.recommended_action: Follow up only with the narrow close-Settings versus Exit-PowerToys discriminator; do not repeat an undifferentiated logs checklist.

comment.body: Thanks for asking how to provide debug data, and for the current-version comparison above. Following the existing Report bug guidance, please test 0.102.3001 by enabling Light Switch, closing only the Settings window (leave PowerToys running in the tray), and reopening the page. Does the Enable Light Switch toggle itself return to Off, or only the theme/schedule state change? Please say if you instead used Exit PowerToys, and comment `/bugreport` immediately after a reset. This identifies the persistence transition without repeating the earlier general collection request.
